status: done: the log and the bosses block name each boss as name (id), e.g. The Deep Freezer (deep-freezer)
request: Put the boss id beside the display name on every log row and in the bosses state block.
why: Damage is attributed to ids such as ketchup-kraken and compost-titan, while the planner and the log show display names such as amusing and The Deep Freezer. Without both on the same row, a run cannot say which boss dealt which damage or aim a goal at that boss.

status: done in part: the game counts healing only in total, so each log row has hp_gained and the outcome gives health gained over the run; match hp_gained rows to food goals
request: Log healing by source the same way hurt_by logs damage.
why: This run gained about 25 hp at 2:17, 3:58 and 4:20 with no food goal. Those rises decide whether the early game is survivable, and no template can see a source the log does not record.

status: done: a stuck goal says standing on it charged nothing, mentions gold only for a spot whose description costs gold (with the gold held), and counts the action model stepping off
request: When a chest goal fails because Tibo stepped off, say that. Mention gold only when the gold held is actually short of the price.
why: At 4:32 a charging chest failed as "it may cost gold Tibo lacks" while Tibo held 510 gold and the action rows show Tibo walking off the tile. That sentence is what the planner reads in recent goals for the next 45 seconds.

status: done: a walk row is written whenever Tibo lost health while the page walked it without asking a model
request: Log a move row whenever health fell since the previous row, including when the forecast priced the step at no damage.
why: From 17:59 to 18:04 health fell from 116 to 52 to boss:ketchup-kraken with no move row. The log drops forecast-safe steps, so a hit the forecast missed never shows the choice, and a review cannot tell whether the model was asked.

status: done: run_end says died or won-then-died, what hurt Tibo in its last 3 seconds, and the damage total
request: On the run_end row, say whether Tibo died or the clock stopped, and name the last damage source.
why: The notes record a death at 18:20. The last row is 17/129, no health lost since 18:10, Ketchup Kraken 289 away, and the detail says survived 18:20. The loop cannot tell what ended the run.

status: done: an evade that lost health ends as the N seconds ran out, and Tibo lost X health; kept clear only when none was lost
request: When an evade goal ends because the timer ran out, say that. If health was lost during the goal, include the hp lost. Reserve the words 'kept clear' for a goal that lost no health.
why: This run's evade goals ended 'kept clear for 8 seconds' at 0:45 (aphid hit, hp 117), 1:55 (hp 93, fry-fly), 2:03 (amusing 40 away, enemies_near 9, hp 69), 3:04 (hp 3) and 3:12 (hp 1). That phrase is what the planner reads in recent goals, and the next goal was evade every time. A template cannot change the reason string.

status: done in part: the outcome gives the damage total and the health gained over the run; the game tracks no per-source split of what is left
request: On the outcome damage list, include every source and a total, and make that total equal the health lost over the run, with an explicit other line for anything left over.
why: This run's listed sources sum to 96 (snow-mold 19 through potato-beetle 7) while health fell from 120 to 1. The gap of about 23 may hide a hazard, a telegraph, a scar or a boss, so the review cannot close the question of what killed Tibo.

status: done: chests give rewards without a choice, so every loadout change is a loadout row and the notes Picks list gained without a pick lines
request: Log chest and shrine picks as pick rows (the chosen card and the odds), and show them in the notes Picks list.
why: This run's four chests raised Root Spikes 3/8 to 7/8 and evolved Taproot Eruption with no pick or evolution row in the log. A review cannot say what each chest gave, or whether the evolution came from a chest pick.

status: done: every move row says in detail whether dash was asked and its probability, or why it was not asked
request: Log the action.dash probability, and whether it was asked, on every step where a dash charge is held and an enemy or bullet is close, even when Tibo walks.
why: The dash charge was used once, at 2:13 at 5 hp, across a crowd that took hp 70 to 17. Without the probability we cannot tell whether the template said no or the question was never asked, so a template change cannot be aimed.
